test=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in test_txt.splitlines()]
def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    frames=[]
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row)-{0}:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
        border={(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)}
        if all(grid[r][c]==color for r,c in border):
            ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
            pat=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0+1,c1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
            frames.append((color,r0,c0,ih,iw,pat))
    for color,r0,c0,ih,iw,pat in frames:
        if any(v!=0 for row in pat for v in row):
            for col2,r2,c2,ih2,iw2,p2 in frames:
                if (ih2,iw2)==(ih,iw) and not any(v!=0 for row in p2 for v in row):
                    for dr in range(ih):
                        for dc in range(iw):
                            if pat[dr][dc]!=0: out[r2+1+dr][c2+1+dc]=col2
    return out
out=transform(test)
print(len(out),len(out[0]))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
